title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays: American Mahjong Open Play Night
description: Mahj Mondays is an open play night for American Mahjong, presented by The Gallery at the Gillioz with Blooming Bams. Drop in or stay the whole evening; admission is free, and several tile sets are provided, though you should bring your own 2026 NMJL card. All skill levels are welcome, but players must already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules), and Blooming Bams offers Mahjong 101 beforehand for newcomers. The Gallery Bar serves alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks, BYO food is welcome, and an RSVP via the Facebook event is requested.
